description: What GET /telemetry/connected-devices/buildings/{buildingId} answers: every device connected in the building at its newest report. Built by telemetry (Rust); read by the frontend.

rules.totalDeviceCount: The sum of the building's rooms' totalDeviceCount at the newest timestamp any room reported it. A router counts the devices it hears, wherever they stand, so the building total is the figure that means what it says.
rules.timestamp: That newest report, epoch milliseconds. A room whose last report is older is left out: its router was removed or moved.
rules.rooms: Each room counts once at that timestamp, so a report delivered twice does not double the total.
rules.absent: A building that never reported a device count answers 404, not zero: nobody measured it.

cases.name: a building's devices at its newest report

rejected.name: a negative count
rejected.reason: totalDeviceCount: a count is never negative

rejected.name: a room
rejected.reason: roomId: not allowed -- this is the building's figure, not a room's

rejected.name: no timestamp
rejected.reason: timestamp: required -- a total without its moment cannot be judged stale
